anomalies.observed: The ESP32 module pin IO5/I2C_SCL is labeled NET0005, and the associated 2.2 kΩ pull-up R54 is also on NET0005. The SCL pins on the isolated pH/EC isolators and the EZO-RTD sensor are labeled NET0006.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification, ESP32-C6 pin IO5/I2C_SCL must be the same main I2C_SCL net as the sensor SCL pins, pulled up to +3V3.

evidence.quote: Netlist: ESP32-C6 pin `IO4/I2C_SDA` → `I2C_SDA` net; pin `IO5/I2C_SCL` → `I2C_SCL` net, each pulled up to `+3V3` via 2.2 kΩ resistors (R3, R4).
SoC tile: M3A pin IO5/I2C_SCL has net label NET0005; I2C Sensors tile: U7 pin 6 SCL1 and U6 pin 6 SCL1 have net label NET0006, as does M1 TX/SCL.

anomalies.impact: The main I2C SCL bus is broken: the MCU cannot clock the I2C bus, so the EZO-RTD, isolated pH/EC channels, and any optional I2C sensors will not communicate. The SCL pull-up is also on the wrong net.

anomalies.observed: The optional environmental/light sensor headers H5 and H9 have their VCC pin connected to +5V, with local decoupling to GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the H5/H6 four-pin I2C sensor headers should break out +3V3, GND, I2C_SCL, and I2C_SDA. BME280 and BH1750 are 3.3 V I2C devices.

evidence.quote: H5, H6 (4-pin JST-PH headers) — each breaks out `+3V3`, `GND`, `I2C_SCL`, `I2C_SDA`.
Light Sensor (optional) H9 JST_PH and Environmental Sensor (optional) H5 JST_PH are drawn with pin 1 on the +5V rail.

anomalies.impact: If the optional BME280/BH1750 sensors or external 3.3 V modules are connected, they may be damaged by 5 V, and their I2C pull-ups may drive the 3.3 V bus to 5 V.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains a broken main I2C SCL net: the ESP32 IO5/SCL and its pull-up are on NET0005, while all sensor SCL pins use NET0006. The optional environmental/light sensor headers are also powered from +5V instead of the specified +3V3 rail.
